results.text: Effect of Scutellarin on the Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Warfarin in Rats. The study aims to investigate the pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetics to elucidate the mechanism of enhanced anticoagulant effect of scutellarin and its preparations on warfarin. Evaluation of pharmacodynamic effects is undertaken by measuring coagulation parameters prothrombin time (PT) and activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT).
